summary: Three ButtonGroups: text buttons (Day, Week, Month), icon buttons (Bold, Italic, Underline) and a filled plus destructive pair.
use: Related actions that read as one control: a range switcher, a formatting toolbar, an approve and reject pair.
spec: `<ButtonGroup aria-label="View range">` with three `variant="outlined" tone="neutral"` Buttons
`<ButtonGroup aria-label="Text style">` with three outlined neutral `IconButton`s, each with an `aria-label`
`<ButtonGroup aria-label="Review">` with a `filled` Approve and a `destructive` Reject
The groups are stacked in a column with `gap: var(--ca-space-3)`
